_note: 買って食べる場（中食）の系譜。品目ハブ（/en/eat/food-shopping/）の横並び表と、各系譜ページがここから描く。出典は docs/research/retail-ekiben-2026-10-10.md と各系譜ページの sources。デパ地下・駅弁の2本は published。スーパー（業務スーパー含む）は素材が薄いので planned、era は「—」。コンビニは別ハブ（conbini）なのでここには行を作らない
name: Buying food to eat
nameJa: 買って食べる（デパ地下・駅弁・スーパー）

origin.place: Department stores, often joined to stations
origin.era: Hankyu’s station market 1925; basement date unconfirmed

cells.what: The food floor of a department store, usually in the basement
cells.buy: Prepared dishes, sweets for gifts, fresh food, sake; some deli food sold by weight
cells.numbers: Food was 25.2% of department store sales in August 2026; sweets 8.7%, deli 6.2% (ex tax)
cells.know: Free samples at some counters; JNTO suggests visiting near closing time

origin.place: Several stations claim it; the first is not settled

cells.what: A boxed meal sold at stations, made to be eaten cold
cells.buy: Regional boxes from under ¥1,000 to about ¥3,000 (JNTO)
cells.numbers: 83 member makers in the trade association (July 2023); over 400 at the peak, by JR West’s report
cells.know: Most buyers now eat it at home; department store ekiben fairs since 1953

cells.what: Everyday grocery stores with a prepared-food section
cells.buy: Deli, bento, onigiri, sushi and in-store bakery, counted together as sōzai
cells.numbers: Sōzai was 11.3% of sales in 2025 (panel of 270 companies, ex tax)
cells.know: Stores discount food to sell it out before closing; how and when varies by store
